SUMMARY
Stunning Three-Bedroom, Two-Bathroom Apartment – White Star Place
Set on the fourth floor of the sought-after White Star Place development, this spacious three-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers modern city living with generous interiors, two balconies, and the convenience of secure parking.

DESCRIPTION
Upon entering, a welcoming hallway with ample built in storage leads you into the heart of the home: an open-plan living and dining room that is immediately inviting. Large windows and full-height sliding doors flood the room with natural light while drawing the eye toward the substantial private balcony.

An elegant archway leads through to the separate fitted kitchen, thoughtfully designed with plentiful cabinetry, integrated appliances, and extensive worktop space. The light wood units and tiled splashbacks create a bright, contemporary feel, and the separate layout ensures both practicality and connection to the main living area.

The property boasts three excellent bedrooms, with even the smallest bedroom being large enough for a double. The main bedroom suite provides a peaceful retreat complete with built-in wardrobes and a well-presented en-suite shower room.
Bedrooms two and three share access to a second private balcony, offering views towards the city. These rooms can serve comfortably as guest rooms or spacious work-from-home areas.

A contemporary family bathroom serves the additional bedrooms, featuring a full-sized bath with overhead shower.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.
